values.name: Agreement
values.description: An agreed status is allocated to delivery requirements.

values.name: Proposal
values.description: The delivery requirements are only a proposal.

values.name: Suggested correction
values.description: A correction status is allocated to previously transmitted delivery requirements.

values.name: Test/do not deliver
values.description: Status indicating delivery information sent for test purposes only, when the same message also contains operational delivery information.

values.name: Already delivered
values.description: The corresponding delivery requirements have already been delivered.
